About Tamarind AI
Tamarind AI builds reliable, human-centered software and analytical platforms used by teams across universities, financial institutions, and distributed engineering organizations. We value clear written communication, careful engineering, and measurable outcomes over buzzwords.

Role Overview: Trust & Safety Engineering Intern
As a Trust & Safety Engineering Intern at Tamarind AI, you will collaborate with product engineers, data scientists, and operations leads to design, test, and ship production workflows. You will participate in weekly design reviews, write well-documented code and unit tests, monitor service reliability, and help improve internal developer tooling.

Requirements & Qualifications
You will build detectors against fake listings that say 'pay Rs 500 registration fee' or 'WhatsApp HR immediately'. Apply before December 14, 2026.
Core skills for this position include Python, SQL, FastAPI. Candidates should be comfortable working with version control, structured data, and collaborative code reviews.

How to Apply
Submit your resume and a short note describing a recent technical or analytical project. We review applications carefully and communicate updates through our official careers portal.
